proposals.title: Monorepo scaffold, strict TypeScript, blocking lint gates, Electron shell, and CI with Windows/Linux installers
proposals.why_now: The repository remains empty after ten consecutive ideation cycles with zero accepted commits. This is the prerequisite for every other proposal: no spec-compliant code can be written without the monorepo structure, TypeScript strict configuration, and the determinism and dependency-boundary lint gates active and blocking in CI. FASE-1 acceptance explicitly requires lint of determinism (by default negation) and lint of dependency frontiers to be blocking before acceptance, and requires a minimum installer for Windows and Linux to be produced by CI — the spec warns that deferred packaging leads to unrecoverable ABI failures. INV-26 and INV-29 cannot be satisfied without the Electron shell existing with correct security settings from its first commit.

proposals.title: Write the three DEFINIR ADRs required before packages/core can be implemented
proposals.why_now: ADR-002 requires the hash function to be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before any rand() implementation. ADR-009 requires the CanonicalEncoder to be specified in its own ADR before any state hash exists — this is an explicit FASE-1 acceptance criterion. ADR-004 marks the technical enforcement mechanism for rounding-mode declaration as DEFINIR. All three must be resolved before packages/core work begins; implementing core before these ADRs embeds unrecorded decisions into the system that cannot be reversed without breaking encodingVersion.

proposals.title: packages/core — branded numeric types, positional RNG, CanonicalEncoder, and arithmetic helpers
proposals.why_now: packages/core is the dependency of every other pure package. Without branded types (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick), the type system cannot enforce ADR-003 or ADR-004 and violations accumulate silently. Without the positional rand(), packages/world cannot be written. Without CanonicalEncoder, no StateHash can be computed and INV-01, INV-17, INV-22 have no foundation. This package must exist before any other domain code. The ADRs from IDEA-002 must precede it.

proposals.title: packages/world price generator, packages/domain ledger and market orders, packages/application canonical tick loop
proposals.why_now: These three packages compose the functional core of FASE-1 and must arrive together because application is the only layer that composes world and domain without coupling them. The price generator is the entry point for INV-02 (the most important test in the project per the spec). The double-entry ledger is the entry point for INV-04 through INV-07. The canonical tick loop implements the ten-step locked order from §7, which is a FASE-1 acceptance criterion. None of these can be verified in isolation against the invariants — they become testable only when composed through application.

proposals.title: tools/replay, tools/bench, and minimum Electron UI to complete FASE-1 acceptance
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance requires tools/replay reporting the first divergent tick, tools/bench with frozen calibration ratios, a minimum UI (price chart via lightweight-charts, balance, buy/sell buttons, pause/1x controls), and the permanent non-dismissable disclaimer required by §20. These complete the remaining FASE-1 acceptance criteria after the core simulation is operational. Deferring the performance baseline freeze past FASE-1 means the bench gate has no reference to compare against for the rest of the project.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — price generator transcendental functions: §5.1 constructs prices in log-space, requiring log and exp. Both are prohibited in pure packages by §13. An ADR specifying fixed-point or lookup-table implementations that produce bit-identical results across platforms must be written before packages/world work begins. This ADR is separate from ADR-002-hash and ADR-009 and has not yet been proposed as a standalone deliverable; it is a prerequisite for IDEA-004.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — octave parameters: the number of octaves, their periods, and amplitudes for trendLayer and idiosyncraticNoise are DEFINIR per §5.1. These parameters must be fixed in a versioned configuration file with an ADR before the price generator is implemented, because any post-implementation change requires an encodingVersion bump and invalidates all reference StateHashes frozen in tools/bench.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — hash function: ADR-002 requires the hash function to be specified bit-exactly in an ADR before any rand() implementation. As of this cycle no such ADR exists. Any rand() written without it embeds an unrecorded decision that cannot be changed without a breaking encodingVersion bump.
